answer: A sybil-proof identity can rest on the FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot certificate: each agent must hold a real certificate number verifiable against the FAA Airman Registry. Earning one costs $175 for the knowledge test at a PSI center, TSA security vetting, and weeks of study — about $800 and a month per identity all-in. A forger crossing that canyon of paperwork hits a ridge of in-person ID checks, and any fake number dies on the ledge of the public registry lookup: the certificate simply does not exist, so the account is frozen before it can earn.
